newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Bangladeshi U.N. soldier dies in Kuwait- U.N..
newsitem.headline: Bangladeshi U.N. soldier dies in Kuwait- U.N..

text.p: A United Nations Bangladeshi soldier died in Kuwait when his vehicle overturned in a demilitarised zone close to the Iraqi border, the U.N. said on Sunday.
A United Nations Iraq-Kuwait Observation Mission (UNIKOM) spokesman said that three Bangladeshi soldiers were also injured in the accident early on Saturday in northern Kuwait.
"The cause of the accident is still under investigation," he told Reuters.
The soldiers are part of a 750-strong Bangladeshi peacekeeping force deployed in the area since 1994 to protect the UNIKOM mission.

UNIKOM military observers and armed peacekeepers are deployed along the 1991 Gulf War frontier to patrol a 15 km (9 mile)-wide strip along the 207 km (130 mile) border in addition to a small portion of the Gulf waterway.
